title: Integer claim keys
description: Restates QR Code Generation, 4. Step 3 — Build the CWT claim set; QR Code Generation, 5. Step 4 — Serialise as CBOR; QR Code Generation, 12.4 The payload; HCERT Specification, 3.2.1 CWT Structure Overview. QR Code Generation, 4. Step 3 — Build the CWT claim set: “Place the payload under its subclaim, inside the hcert claim, inside a CWT claim set”. QR Code Generation, 5. Step 4 — Serialise as CBOR: “The JSON shown throughout this page and in the logical models is schema notation only”.

statements.label: Integer claim keys
statements.requirement: The CWT claim set SHALL use the integer keys 1 (iss), 6 (iat), 4 (exp) and -260 (hcert). The hcert map SHALL use integer subclaim keys. The quoted keys in the documentation ("1", "-260", "-6") are JSON notation only and SHALL NOT be emitted as text keys.

successCriteria.criterion: A test named after STT-CWT-001 passes in each implementation's suite (Kotlin: `STT-CWT-001 STT-CWT-002 claim keys are integers and dates are integer NumericDates` (BuildCwtTest.kt)).
